<observations>
Date: May 31 - Jun 9, 2026
* 🔴 User financial profile & goals: Planning July mountain trip and Asheville trip (budget $600, using Horizon Travel Rewards Card). Maintaining emergency fund in Ally savings ($12,980 balance) and tracking accounts (Chase checking, Fidelity 401k, etc.).
* 🟡 Completed financial planning: Finalized student loan consolidation recommendation, recommended debt avalanche repayment over snowball, and prioritized Sunrise Card payoff ($2,500 at 22.99% APR with $300 biweekly payments).
* 🟡 Financial research & setup: Explored mortgage refinancing (best rate CreditUnion at 3.00%), solar panel tax credits (30%), and set up automated $200 monthly transfer to Fidelity brokerage.

Date: Jun 13, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User scheduled a $1,200 credit card payment for June 15 to manage credit utilization.
* 🟡 (11:20) Created digital 'TaxDocs' cloud folder for medical expense receipts (estimated $800 deduction); tax deadline noted as April 15, 2027.

Date: Jun 17, 2026
* 🔴 (07:05) User set up a recurring $800/month transfer from checking to savings for a house down payment goal ($12,980 current balance).
* 🔴 (08:30) User plans to refinance $9,500 car loan (3.9% APR) to a personal loan at 3.5% APR to lower monthly payment to $220; application scheduled for June 20.
* 🔴 (16:20) User tracks spending using the YNAB iOS app, version 3.12.1.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Acknowledge the user's YNAB setup and upcoming car loan refinance application (June 20).
- Secondary: Pending follow-up on car loan application and travel budget preparations.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"Got it, you're using YNAB v3.12.1 to track expenses. Your car loan refinancing application is scheduled for June 20. Let me know if you need help preparing any documents for the refinance or adjusting your budget further!"
</suggested-response>
